title: xmltoedifact action
description: Converts the XML form of an EDIFACT interchange, as Smooks writes it, into EDIFACT with the default delimiters. An element named by three upper-case characters (BGM, UNB, ...) is a segment, its children its data elements, and a child with children a composite; the elements above segments are walked through. The conversion is structural: it does not know the message definitions, so an element the XML omits is not restored as an empty position; leave it in the XML, empty, to keep it.

edifactType.title: EDIFACT version
edifactType.description: Message directory, such as d96a; accepted for compatibility, the conversion does not depend on it
